title: Russian Drone Strikes Hit Kyiv Again, Killing 1 and Injuring 16 Including Children
detail: Russia resumed drone attacks on Kyiv in daytime hours on September 9, killing 1 person and injuring at least 16, including two children aged 15 and 16, and damaging residential buildings across the capital. A Russian drone struck a 24-story residential building in the Darnytskyi district at around 8 a.m. local time, hitting the structure at the 11th and 12th floors and sparking a fire on the 12th floor that tore through interior walls; five people were injured in the building, three hospitalized, and rescuers evacuated 23 residents. The attack came a day after Russia's mass missile-and-drone barrage killed 5 and injured 70 nationwide following the expiry of the truce tied to US envoy visits, and the same day President Trump held an hour-long call with Putin.
